restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมโปรเด็นท์ สาขาสาย 3 ทวีวัฒนา Prodent Dental Clinic
text:
Before my visit, I called to book an appointment with the staff and informed them that I needed treatment for a broken molar. The staff confirmed that my appointment was complete and I could arrive at the scheduled time.

Upon arrival at the clinic, the doctor informed me that they couldn't treat my tooth and that I had to wait for a specialist...??

My question is, if there's no specialist, why make an appointment? I wasted a whole day waiting for treatment, only to not receive it, even though I called beforehand to specify that I needed treatment for a broken molar.

In short, I only received a scaling procedure...

Regarding the scaling, the doctor initially followed the standard procedure, but they did not perform
polishing, which was quite surprising because other clinics always include this step. I'm unsure of the reason why they didn't. Even with social security insurance, there were additional charges. If the service was better and there were additional costs, I would gladly pay.

The mirror the nurse provided was covered in dirt.

And the mouthwash felt like it hadn't been cleaned by the previous user; there were bits of vegetables stuck to it.

I was initially terrified of dental work, but I was very impressed with my experience.
I have another appointment next time and plan to bring my niece to this clinic. I highly recommend it!
There's convenient parking too. 💗💗💗👍🏻👍🏻

The staff looked at each other and said they thought it was the same person (there was another person who had her teeth cleaned as well), then asked if they were still going to do it. I said no, and didn't reschedule my mom's appointment. I paid and went home. The staff didn't apologize or solve the problem. The entire time I was sitting there, they were talking the whole time, but they didn't do a good job. They were very neglectful. The whole time I was waiting, I was waiting inside and didn't go anywhere, but the staff forgot. They don't have to be the best, but they should do a little better.
